name: Quizizz
tagline: Your pace. Your answers. One finish line.
description: Race through questions on your phone while the room follows every runner on the stage. Correct answers build a streak and earn energy: double your next correct answer or freeze a rival for three seconds. Most points wins.
howToPlay: Answer on your phone, then tap Next. Everyone races at their own pace.
Correct answers score 100 plus a streak bonus. Three correct answers earn one energy.
Use energy to double your next correct score or freeze a rival for 3 s. Most points wins.
